findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email_grade, email_template, slugify · Private data: deliverability_audit, email_grade, email_template, hash_text, jwt_decode, uuid_batch, slugify, json_tools, regex_test, crypto_price, domain_age, weather · Public sink: email_grade, email_template.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email_grade, email_template, slugify · Private data: deliverability_audit, email_grade, email_template, hash_text, jwt_decode, uuid_batch, slugify, json_tools, regex_test, crypto_price, domain_age, weather · Public sink: email_grade, email_template

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
